sections.title: Hotfix Update
sections.description: This is a hotfix update. Replay codes from the November 3 patch are still available.

changes.text_en: Base speed limit for Wrecking Ball while retracting Grappling Claw increased by 15%.
changes.metric: base speed limit for wrecking ball while retracting grappling claw
changes.raw_metric: base speed limit for wrecking ball while retracting grappling claw

changes.text_en: Allied speed boosts now increase the speed limit for Wrecking Ball while retracting Grappling Claw.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: - Players who did not reach Checkpoint 4 in a previous Competitive Drive should no longer have a signature equipped which they cannot unequip.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - In a previous update, fixed an issue where pilot D.Mon would be resurrected without ultimate charge, thereby preventing D.Mon from immediately getting back into her mech.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: - Fixed an issue where the Scoreboard and related screens would not display properly.
